state.review: Second-stage focused review of low-consensus boundary judgments. The catalog is a proposal under review; selected choices are not assumed correct. Distinguish business authority from private process state and preserve independently governed lifecycle.

owners.invariant: One personal management acknowledgement bound to exact engagement revision and complete service history.
owners.mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.

owners.invariant: Finding description, status and closure admission generation.
owners.mustPreserve: Close only with at least one action, all complete, evidence/rationale present and independent closer unless exact waiver. Closed finding is immutable until reopen.

owners.identity: Tenant / program-rollovers / RolloverId, with exact source program/version and successor proof. RolloverId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId.
owners.invariant: One exact carry-forward proposal version needs independent approved decision before recording exact successor period/plan identities; completed source provenance remains immutable.
owners.rationale: Proposal/current approval and execution claim must coordinate to prevent approved version changing while successor is created. Prior proposal history is unnecessary state; successor creation acknowledgement belongs to recoverable process storage.

engagement_boundary.instructions: Which is the soundest owner boundary for EngagementManagementAcknowledgement?

criteria.separate_decision: Keep an independently identified personal acknowledgement because it has its own author, immutable evidence and lifecycle, bound to an exact engagement revision and complete service history.
criteria.absorb_into_engagement: Store the acknowledgement on ServiceEngagementIndependence because it is part of that owner’s own versioned state and cannot change independently.
criteria.process_only: Treat it as private process progress rather than a durable business decision.
criteria.insufficient: The supplied facts do not establish its independent authority or lifecycle.

engagement_evidence.instructions: Is there enough source-backed evidence here to justify a separate acknowledgement owner rather than an event on ServiceEngagementIndependence?

criteria.true: The acknowledgement has independent personal authority, identity, immutable content or lifecycle that the service owner should not own.
criteria.false: The acknowledgement is only a subordinate fact of the service decision and no independent lifecycle is established.

finding_boundary.instructions: Which boundary best preserves finding closure invariants and independent corrective-action lifecycle?

criteria.selected_split: Keep one FindingAggregate per finding; CorrectiveAction has its own lifecycle, and closure coordinates exact child proofs through a durable process.
criteria.combined_root: Put corrective-action histories in the finding root because closure needs to validate them atomically.
criteria.split_finding_further: Split finding closure admission/status into another business owner.
criteria.insufficient: The supplied facts do not establish bounded history, atomicity, or closure recovery.

finding_evidence.instructions: Can finding closure be made safe without putting independently changing corrective-action histories in the finding aggregate?

criteria.true: Exact admission/fence and child terminal proofs with recoverable process coordination preserve closure under races and restart.
criteria.false: Closure needs an atomic state unavailable across the separate owners, and the proposed coordination cannot preserve it.

rollover_boundary.instructions: Which split of ProgramRollover business decisions and execution is best supported?

criteria.proposal_owner_private_execution: ProgramRollover owns the exact proposal and independent approval; private durable process storage owns execution claim/progress and source-bound successor acknowledgements.
criteria.all_in_business_aggregate: The same business aggregate should own proposal, approval and execution progress/acknowledgements.
criteria.process_only: There is no enduring business decision; all rollover state is private process state.
criteria.insufficient: The supplied facts do not establish the approval/execution concurrency boundary.

rollover_evidence.instructions: Does the supplied rationale require a durable execution process separate from the business proposal and approval owner?

criteria.true: Execution must pin an approved version while creating independent successors and recover exact progress without keeping unnecessary proposal history as process state.
criteria.false: There is no cross-owner or restartable execution requiring process state separate from the business decision.

unresolved_boundary.instructions: Do these three selected definitions leave a known aggregate/process boundary assumption unresolved or internally contradictory?

criteria.true: At least one owner has an unclear business-versus-process classification, independent lifecycle, atomic invariant, or recovery boundary.
criteria.false: Each selected boundary is internally consistent and the described alternatives are ruled out by explicit facts.
